title: jmap-chat-spec: compliance doc errors (PushSubscription/changes; push default spaceId/spaceName)
description: For Mark (no spec commits without approval): compliance §12.1 asks for PushSubscription/changes, which RFC 8620 §7.2 does not define; §6.3 expects spaceId and spaceName by default, which the push draft leaves out of the default properties. Also reconcile §3.1/§13.1 (COVERED via testjig) with §3.2-3.5 (consumer builds the Session). From audit JMAP-x3lu (docs/audits/2026-11-19-x3lu/, jmap-chat-spec 120db2c).
notes: 2026-11-19: spec patch drafted for Mark's review in docs/upstream/2026-11-19/spec-patches/ (see README there); not committed to jmap-chat-spec.
